transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I suppose what finally made me come in is that my appetite has been all over the place for a few months now. 

I've had stretches where I just skip dinner entirely... I've actually lost some weight without trying to. Or other nights I'll just pick at crackers or a bowl of cereal. Cooking for myself just feels sort of pointless lately. So... that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

I suppose... maybe a little. I still try to go through the motions with things I normally like. Watering the garden, showing up to my book club... things like that. 

But it mostly just feels... flat, I guess. I usually end up leaving early. Or sometimes I just don't bother starting at all.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past few weeks?
I don't know about every day. Um... maybe? I haven't really been keeping track like that. It's just... I guess things have felt a bit heavier lately. But I wouldn't say it's all the time.
Would you say that most days, you've been feeling down or depressed for most of the day?
I'm not really sure. I haven't been keeping a log or anything. It's just... I guess I've just been feeling a bit off. I don't know if I'd call it depressed most of the day.
Over the past two weeks, have you had days where you felt down or depressed for most of the day?

I suppose... maybe a day or two like that? Like I was saying, I haven't really been paying that close attention to the exact timeline. Some days are just... a bit harder to get through than others. But I don't know if it's the whole day.
Over the past few weeks, have you found yourself losing interest in activities you used to enjoy, like your garden or book club?

Um... I guess I still do them. I still water the plants. I still go to the book club meetings. But... I don't know, it just feels kind of flat. Sometimes I don't even finish watering, or I'll leave the meeting early. I just... don't really feel like being there.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say that on most days you felt down or depressed for most of the day?

I... I think we just talked about this. I really don't know if it's most days. Like I said, I haven't been keeping track. I just... I don't feel like myself, but I couldn't tell you if it's every single day or for how long.
